notes: GPT-6 Astra Pro; effort not exposed; reader_a; first reading. The original whole page and both native halves were each viewed once, followed by twelve saved crops, one per remaining open locus. No OCR, external research, TeX compilation or other-page source was used.

No author page number is visible on this sheet. Lower-left archive folio 97 is in a smaller, thinner and lighter hand, attributed only to another unnamed archive-foliation hand. Its metadata treatment is not counted as a substantive witness difference.

The page begins as a continuation with évidente. The original main compatibility clause ends with a period. The added degree condition is interwoven with two older cancelled rows and ends with doit without a written completion; no missing predicate is supplied.

The degree reference in that addition is visibly (52), although the preceding application (51) appears to be the degree-bearing map. Both the written reference and display label (52) are preserved. This is a contextual observation, not a verified theorem or a proof event.

The main existence sentence reads bel et bien un tilde Theta qui l’induise; et is underlined. The small map and its compatibility condition form a separate insertion. Two old crossed clusters, under that map and beneath the later E0, remain doubtful.

The component functor pi0 in (52) is kept distinct from the acting-group Pi in the insertion. The small handwritten outlines overlap in form, so notation and grammatical role decide the transcription; case is not mechanically propagated from the large capital Pi1 below.

The final paragraph says the author has apparently forgotten the most important condition while constantly working with it. Parmi ces, sur and apparemment are retained from the ink. The full second reading prefers live pourtant with a deleted alternative because the long line may be a shared t-crossbar; the paragraph closes with an exclamation mark.

The margin opening remains unresolved. Its preferred literal rendering records a tall l-like loop and equals-like strokes plus a point; the alternate On lie is not certified. There is no secure terminal point after conditions.
The unreadable cancelled run after Rien qu’en has unknown extent. The placeholder illegible{?} explicitly avoids asserting C’s unverified count of three words.

The first subagent transcribed and contextually identified the mathematics without claiming a proof check. The main reader separately performed the ordinary G-set checks recorded below as 142-098-R1 and R2.

H textit stable and un are treated as encoding the source underlines, not as substantive macro differences. The graphical strokes on this page are correction/attachment leaders and cancellation strokes; no independent drawing or diagram beyond the written map expressions was found.

Main-reader check 142-098-R1: for an automorphism a of G, an a-semilinear bijection of a G-set E induces a component bijection b commuting with the stabilizer-class map q. Conversely, after choosing representatives x and y with Stab(y)=a(Stab(x)), the formula gx ↦ a(g)y is well defined and bijective on each paired orbit. Their disjoint union gives a lift. This verifies the ordinary G-set criterion under those assumptions; no separate claim about geometric equivalences or topology is proved.

Main-reader check 142-098-R2 concerns only the weaker auxiliary reading that stability of the image of q alone suffices. For G=C2×C2, let a swap its two coordinate subgroups H1 and H2 and take E to have one G/H1 orbit and two G/H2 orbits. Its set of orbit types is stable but their multiplicities cannot be bijected. The refined criterion is 142-098-R1. The added words about degree/cardinal of the fibre address multiplicities, but stop at doit; the text is not completed from this argument.

The complete second reading corrects connaît to connait in quand on connait ses valeurs. The first focused crop shows a compact vertical oval i point with no two-sided roof; the main reader independently inspected it. Both witnesses supplied the circumflex.

At pourtant, the first consolidation treated the long line above the right-hand letters as a strike. Auditor and main reader independently reused the crop and found that the line joins the two t stems at crossbar height, above the low a/n bodies. Live pourtant is now preferred, with deletion retained as an explicit alternative. The original deletion-only certainty is withdrawn and the inventory entry is text with uncertain cancellation.

All 34 inherited comparison loci, 18 decisions, eight old certainty entries and 22 inventory elements were reviewed. The 11 inherited doubts remain and the newly reopened state of pourtant brings the total to 12. No missing element or mathematical check event.

check_events.outcome: Conditional lifting criterion at the ordinary G-set level: let a be an automorphism of G and q:E/G→{conjugacy classes of subgroups of G} send an orbit to its stabilizer class. An a-semilinear bijection of E induces a bijection b of E/G with q(b(O))=a(q(O)). Conversely, given such b, choose x in each O and y in b(O); conjugate y within its orbit to arrange Stab(y)=a(Stab(x)). Then gx↦a(g)y is well-defined and a bijection on that orbit. Taking the disjoint union gives the required semilinear bijection. This proves the stated lifting step for ordinary G-sets under those assumptions. It does not separately prove the geometric equivalence, continuous topology conditions beyond the orbit model, or complete the manuscript's unfinished inserted sentence.

Let G=C2×C2 and let a interchange the two coordinate subgroups H1,H2. For E=(G/H1) disjoint union two copies of (G/H2), the image {H1,H2} is a-stable, but a-semilinearity would require a bijection between one H1-type orbit and two H2-type orbits, impossible. The refined criterion is 142-098-R1, equivalently matching multiplicities of orbit types. The author's added words about degree/cardinal of the fiber address exactly this extra issue but stop at doit; no completion is supplied.
